les-arcs.signatureHook: Birthplace of speed skiing — world records broken on its steep faces

verbier.signatureHook: Gateway to the 4 Vallées — 412km of pistes across four linked Swiss valleys

val-thorens.signatureHook: Highest ski resort in Europe at 2,300m altitude

avoriaz.signatureHook: Entirely car-free resort perched on dramatic 1,000m cliff faces above Morzine

kitzbuhel.signatureHook: Home of the Hahnenkamm Downhill — the most feared race on the World Cup circuit

meribel.signatureHook: Sits at the geographical heart of the Trois Vallées ski area

lech.signatureHook: Exclusive village and long-time favourite of European royalty and celebrities

la-plagne.signatureHook: Hosted the 1992 Olympic bobsleigh and luge events — track still in use

alpe-dhuez.signatureHook: Famous for the 21 hairpin bends of the Tour de France cycling climb

zermatt.signatureHook: Car-free village beneath the Matterhorn — one of the world's most iconic mountain silhouettes

obertauern.signatureHook: Guaranteed snow from November to May — unique bowl topography traps every snowfall

st-moritz.signatureHook: Only resort to have hosted the Winter Olympics twice — 1928 and 1948

sestriere.signatureHook: Italy's first purpose-built ski resort — constructed by Fiat founder Giovanni Agnelli in 1934

cervinia.signatureHook: Cross-border skiing into Zermatt on the shared Matterhorn glacier plateau

mayrhofen.signatureHook: Home to Austria's steepest groomed piste — the near-vertical Harakiri run at 78°

solden.signatureHook: Featured as the villain's mountaintop lair in the James Bond film Spectre

serre-chevalier.signatureHook: Largest ski area in the Southern Alps — 13 linked villages near Briançon

les-gets.signatureHook: Home to one of the world's largest mechanical music box museums

tignes.signatureHook: Year-round glacier skiing on the Grande Motte at 3,456m

crans-montana.signatureHook: Panoramic sunny plateau with unobstructed views of 10 four-thousand-metre Alpine peaks

chamonix.signatureHook: Home of the legendary Vallée Blanche — 20km off-piste descent from 3,842m

morzine.signatureHook: Traditional Alpine village straddling the French-Swiss border in the Portes du Soleil

bormio.signatureHook: Ancient Roman thermal spa town — regular World Cup downhill venue since 1985

kaprun.signatureHook: Year-round glacier skiing on the Kitzsteinhorn at 3,029m above Zell am See

saalbach.signatureHook: Part of the Skicircus — a famous ski loop linking four valley villages without removing skis

saas-fee.signatureHook: Car-free glacier resort known as the Pearl of the Alps — surrounded by 13 four-thousanders

les-deux-alpes.signatureHook: Shares Europe's largest skiable glacier at 3,600m with neighbouring Alpe d'Huez

ischgl.signatureHook: Famous for massive free outdoor concerts headlined by global pop acts at season's end

zell-am-see.signatureHook: Rare combination of glacier skiing and a sparkling lakeside town in the same resort

zurs.signatureHook: Tiny exclusive hamlet linked to Lech and St. Anton — one of the smallest resorts in the Arlberg

alta-badia.signatureHook: Hosts the Gran Risa — a World Cup giant slalom run through stunning pink-tinged Dolomite scenery

laax.signatureHook: Home to the world's biggest halfpipe and Europe's largest indoor skatepark — snowboard mecca

schladming.signatureHook: Regular host of the FIS Night Slalom — thousands of spectators line the floodlit course

bad-gastein.signatureHook: Belle Époque spa town — a spectacular waterfall plunges through the centre of the village

la-clusaz.signatureHook: Traditional Savoyard village just 30 minutes from Geneva — France's closest major resort to the city

megeve.signatureHook: Founded by Baroness de Rothschild as France's answer to St. Moritz

grindelwald.signatureHook: Sits directly below the sheer north face of the Eiger — one of mountaineering's greatest challenges

cortina-dampezzo.signatureHook: Hosted the 1956 Winter Olympics and co-hosts the 2026 Winter Games

livigno.signatureHook: Duty-free enclave — the only Italian resort where no VAT applies to goods and fuel

val-disere.signatureHook: Co-hosted the 1992 Winter Olympics downhill events

val-gardena.signatureHook: World Cup downhill and Super-G venue on the iconic Saslong course every December

courchevel.signatureHook: Private altiport runway at 2,000m — arrive by private jet

andermatt.signatureHook: Former Swiss Army training ground transformed into a luxury resort by Egyptian billionaire Samih Sawiris

wengen.signatureHook: Car-free village reached only by cog railway — perched above the Lauterbrunnen valley

st-anton.signatureHook: Widely considered the birthplace of modern alpine skiing technique

davos.signatureHook: World's largest natural ice rink and annual home of the World Economic Forum

madonna-di-campiglio.signatureHook: Winter retreat of Emperor Franz Joseph I of Austria — favoured by Habsburg royalty
